# Blue Line Removals

> Melbourne house and office removalist and junk-removal company. Free quotes (no call-out fee), fully insured, same-day booking usually available. Junk collected is donated or recycled ahead of landfill wherever possible.

Blue Line Removals is based in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia (ABN 90 701 004 480) and services the greater Melbourne metro area, including the CBD, inner city, eastern, western, northern, southern, and Mornington Peninsula regions.

## Services

- [Home Removals](https://www.bluelineremovals.com.au/services/home-removals): Local and suburban house moves, including furniture disassembly/reassembly and flexible weekend scheduling.
- [Office Removals](https://www.bluelineremovals.com.au/services/office-removals): Business relocations planned around operating hours, including IT equipment and secure document handling.
- [Interstate Removals](https://www.bluelineremovals.com.au/services/interstate-removals): Full-service moves across Australian states and territories, insured in transit.
- [Junk Removal](https://www.bluelineremovals.com.au/services/junk-removal): Furniture, appliance, garden, garage, construction, and e-waste removal, sorted for donation/recycling before landfill.
- [Packing & Unpacking](https://www.bluelineremovals.com.au/services/packing-unpacking): Full or partial packing service with materials supplied, plus unpacking on request.
- [Storage Solutions](https://www.bluelineremovals.com.au/services/storage-solutions): Short- and long-term storage in a secure, monitored facility, month-to-month terms.
- [Specialty Items](https://www.bluelineremovals.com.au/services/specialty-items): Pianos, pool tables, antiques, and other fragile or awkward items, handled with specialist equipment.

## Key facts

- Fully insured: public liability and goods-in-transit cover on every job.
- First-time customers get 10% off their first booking.
- 8+ years in business, 11,000+ moves completed, 5,000+ customers served.
